pictures.name: first_course_of_stone
pictures.scene: a low course of dressed stone laid out on bare ground as the beginning of a house, the cut blocks lit warm and hard from one side along the bottom of the frame, the ground above them open and dim

pictures.name: tower_on_the_wall
pictures.scene: a squat stone watchtower standing at the corner of a city wall, its base lit by one warm lamp low in the frame, the tower and the wall above it rising into a deep and cloudless night

pictures.name: lamp_burned_low
pictures.scene: a small clay lamp burned almost out on a rough wooden bench, a last thread of flame and a thin curl of smoke at the bottom of the frame, the room above it filled with cold and undisturbed dark

pictures.name: sleeping_mat
pictures.scene: an empty sleeping mat and a folded blanket laid out on a swept earth floor beside a shuttered window, warm dawn light reaching in low across the mat, the room above it soft and brown and still

pictures.name: nest_of_eggs
pictures.scene: a deep grass nest holding four pale speckled eggs, tucked low in the fork of a thorn tree and lit warm from beneath, the branches above it thin and dark against a wide and empty morning sky

pictures.name: quiver_of_arrows
pictures.scene: a leather quiver standing upright in the dust, packed full of straight fletched arrows, its lower half lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the plain behind it flat and dim to the horizon

pictures.name: gate_held_open
pictures.scene: a heavy timber city gate standing wide open with its great bar drawn back and set aside, the threshold lit warm and low, the archway above it deep and dark and holding no detail at all

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.
Unless the LORD builds the house,
unless the LORD protects the city,
its watchmen stand guard in vain.
for He gives sleep to His beloved.
Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD,
and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior,
so are children born in one’s youth.
whose quiver is full of them.
He will not be put to shame
when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
